en-us.fixclothes_expel_question: Straightening up in front of the mirror, $self.name$ still has something in the mouth. Spit it out?
en-us.fixclothes_expel_declined: $self.name$ doesn't spit, leaving it in the mouth.
en-us.fixclothes_expel_mouth: $self.name$ leans over the sink, spits out what was in the mouth and rinses. $fixMouthMsg$.
en-us.fixclothes_wash: $self.name$ splashes water on the face. Washed off: $fixWashReport$.
en-us.fixclothes_plain: $self.name$ straightens their clothes and takes a breather.
